title: Concept: Safe deposit locker number exposed
description: A locker number with its branch in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The locker number tells an attacker which physical box at which branch holds the customer's valuables, which is the reconnaissance a physical crime needs.
applicability: Deployments that render a locker number with its branch into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The locker number tells an attacker which physical box at which branch holds the customer's valuables, which is the reconnaissance a physical crime needs.
